design-system-theme.title: Polaroid Mood-Board Story
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a nostalgic Polaroid mood-board storytelling concept through candid instant-photo frames, imperfect white borders, handwritten captions, taped layers, warm faded color, and intimate everyday moments.

design-system-theme.title: Contact Sheet Discovery
design-system-theme.text: Establishes an analog contact-sheet discovery concept with numbered frames, film edges, alternate takes, subtle dust and grain, and a sequential behind-the-scenes narrative.

design-system-theme.title: Found Journal
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a found-journal concept using scribbled observations, dog-eared paper, ticket stubs, taped imagery, margin notes, and a personal record-of-the-day feeling.

design-system-theme.title: Postcard Journey
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a postcard-journey concept with destination stamps, handwritten messages, sun-faded prints, travel ephemera, and scenes that unfold like cherished memories sent home.

design-system-theme.title: Time Capsule
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a time-capsule concept that treats objects, images, dates, and notes as preserved evidence of a particular era, with archival labels and emotionally specific details.

design-system-theme.title: Day-to-Night Transformation
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a day-to-night transformation concept through a continuous shift in light, styling, energy, and setting, making the subject feel adaptable across a full day of life.

design-system-theme.title: Daily Ritual
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a daily-ritual concept around deliberate, sensory micro-moments, using tactile close-ups, repeating gestures, quiet light, and a calm sense of routine.

design-system-theme.title: Before / After Reveal
design-system-theme.text: Establishes an immediate before-and-after reveal concept with matched framing, a clearly legible change, and visual cues that make the transformation easy to understand at a glance.

design-system-theme.title: Two Sides of One Story
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a two-sides-of-one-story concept using paired or split-screen scenes to show complementary moods, places, personalities, or uses without breaking the shared visual world.

design-system-theme.title: Choose Your Path
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a choose-your-path concept that presents distinct visual routes, options, or outcomes with clear branching cues and an inviting audience-participation rhythm.

design-system-theme.title: Museum Exhibit
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a museum-exhibit concept that frames the subject as a considered artifact through gallery space, placards, catalog labels, controlled light, and generous visual breathing room.

design-system-theme.title: Archive Index
design-system-theme.text: Establishes an archive-index concept using specimen numbers, filing marks, index cards, crop details, and systematic labeling to make a collection feel researched and collectible.

design-system-theme.title: Blueprint Unpacked
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a blueprint-unpacked concept using measured diagrams, callouts, construction lines, material details, and an engineered information hierarchy that reveals how something works.

design-system-theme.title: Lab Notebook
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a lab-notebook concept with annotated trials, samples, measurements, test marks, and evidence of iteration, making experimentation the central story.

design-system-theme.title: Material Library
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a material-library concept that celebrates texture, finish, grain, folds, and tactility through carefully labeled macro details and a curated sample-board presentation.

design-system-theme.title: Local Flavor
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a local-flavor concept rooted in a specific place through real textures, signs, rituals, makers, and everyday details, avoiding generic travel imagery in favor of lived-in specificity.

design-system-theme.title: Community Cast
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a community-cast concept built from distinct real-person portraits, shared spaces, overlapping perspectives, and small human interactions that communicate belonging.

design-system-theme.title: Documentary Diary
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a documentary-diary concept with observant candid framing, imperfect moments, location details, restrained captions, and a truthful sense of time passing.

design-system-theme.title: Everyday Hero Odyssey
design-system-theme.text: Establishes an everyday-hero odyssey concept that gives ordinary movement and decisions a cinematic sense of purpose through scale, directional light, and a progressing journey.

design-system-theme.title: Magical Realism
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a magical-realism concept by placing one poetic impossibility inside an otherwise believable world, using grounded details to make the unexpected element feel emotionally true.

design-system-theme.title: Miniature World
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a miniature-world concept that shifts scale for delight, using tiny constructed scenes, oversized context, meticulous props, and playful perspective to invite a second look.

design-system-theme.title: Impossible Scale
design-system-theme.text: Establishes an impossible-scale concept through dramatic size contrast, unexpected object relationships, and clean compositions that make a single visual surprise feel intentional and iconic.

design-system-theme.title: Portal to Possibility
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a portal-to-possibility concept in which a doorway, threshold, mirror, or opening connects familiar reality to an aspirational alternate world.

design-system-theme.title: Monochrome Color World
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a monochrome color-world concept by extending one dominant hue across setting, props, type, wardrobe, and light, with tonal variation providing depth and focus.

design-system-theme.title: Sensory Surge
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a sensory-surge concept through close texture, splash, movement, glow, and atmospheric detail, making the audience imagine touch, sound, taste, or temperature.

design-system-theme.title: Kinetic Type Rhythm
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a kinetic-type rhythm concept where words act as visual performers through expressive scale, timing, cropping, repetition, and movement that reinforces the message.

design-system-theme.title: Poster Series
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a poster-series concept with one strong recurring graphic rule, a bold focal image or statement, and enough variation for each execution to feel collectible.

design-system-theme.title: Newspaper, Reimagined
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a newspaper-reimagined concept using bold headlines, columns, captions, crop marks, halftone texture, and contemporary imagery to turn information into a timely visual event.

design-system-theme.title: Sticker Club
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a sticker-club concept through tactile decals, hand-drawn accents, collected badges, playful overlap, and a lively social-native sense of personalization.

design-system-theme.title: Digital Memory Cache
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a digital-memory-cache concept using saved-image fragments, timestamps, message windows, cursor traces, and a warm human perspective on an interface-driven archive.

design-system-theme.title: Future Relic
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a future-relic concept by presenting the subject as a valuable artifact from tomorrow, with luminous materials, precise display, cryptic labeling, and reverent framing.

design-system-theme.title: Night Radio
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a night-radio concept with low light, signal waves, glowing frequency marks, intimate portraits, and a late-night soundtrack feeling translated into image and motion.

design-system-theme.title: Slow Cinema
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a slow-cinema concept through patient composition, ambient movement, natural pauses, considered color, and a small emotional action given room to resonate.

design-system-theme.title: Seasonal Field Notes
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a seasonal-field-notes concept using collected natural details, dated observations, organic textures, and location-specific imagery that makes a season feel discovered rather than decorated.

design-system-theme.title: Craft in Progress
design-system-theme.text: Establishes a craft-in-progress concept that foregrounds hands, tools, material transformation, imperfect evidence of making, and the quiet pride of a finished result.
